registration: prospective local protocol, saved before execution; not an external preregistration
scope: adapted mechanistic replication of soft-target stationarity, not a reproduction of all paper training outcomes
teacher_stop: first 25-step checkpoint after minimum with 100 percent training accuracy, else maximum; all outcomes retained
initialization: both students are exact state copies of the trained frozen teacher
primary_endpoint: L2 parameter displacement from teacher after 2000 full-batch Adam steps
hypothesis: fixed gradients preserve exact stationarity; standard arithmetic can induce drift
acceptance: complete all declared seeds and checkpoints; fixed exact stationarity; independent backend preflight and source/data provenance; standard drift is an outcome, never a pass criterion
analysis: show every seed; descriptive comparison only, no significance or training-generalisation claim
